div.head: II Cn 63
div.ab: Gif hwa reaflac gewyrce, agyfe ⁊ forgylde, ⁊ beo his weres scyldig wið þone cingc (oððe wið þone þe his socne age).
Reaflac. Gyf hwa reaflac gewyrce, agyue ⁊ forgylde, ⁊ beo his weres scyldig wið ðone kinincg.
Gif hwa reaflac gewyrce, agife ⁊ forgylde, ⁊ beo his weres scyldig wið þonne cyningc.
Si quis robariam faciat, reddat et persoluat, et wérę suę reus sit erga regem.
Si quis rapinam fecerit, soluat et persoluat, et sit reus pretii sui contra regem.
Si quis rapinam patrauerit, soluat et persoluat, et sit reus sue redempcionis erga regem.
Reaflac. Gyf hwa reaflac gewyrce, agyue ⁊ forgylde ⁊ beo his weres scyldig wið ðone kinincg.
Gif hwa reaflac gewyrce, agyfe and forgylde, and beo his weres scyldig wið þone cingc oððe wið þone þe his socne age.
(Raub. B) Wenn einer Raub verübt, erstatte und zahle er [es] nochmals, und sei gegenüber dem König sein Wergeld schuldig (oder gegenüber demjenigen, der Gerichtsbarkeit über ihn besitzt G).
(Robbery. B) If anyone commits robbery, let him return [it] and pay [it] again, and be liable for his wergild to the king (or to the one who holds jurisdiction over him, G).
Robbery. If anyone is guilty of robbery, he shall restore [the stolen goods], and pay the injured man as much again, and forfeit his wergeld to the king.
If anyone commits robbery, he is to restore and pay as much again, and forfeit his wergild to the king.
If anyone commits a robbery, he must make restoration and compensation, and his wergild is to be forfeit to the king or to the authority that holds jurisdiction.

div.note: The words in brackets ‘oððe wið þone þe his socne age’ are only in G; Liebermann thinks them not original (as in 37).; BR: added from Gesetze I p. 353, October 2026 (MS Cons)

note.seg: oððe — age fehlt übrigen [wie in 37 nicht original]
oððe — age lacking in the others [as in 37, not original]
Aus Inst benutzt durch Ps Cn for 23.—Vgl. Gl Raub 4b gegen 1; Wergeld 30u
Used, from Inst, by Ps Cn for 23.—Cf. Gl Raub 4b as against 1; Wergeld 30u
Dies liegt auch im Latein. persolvere; s. o. 24, 1²
This is implied in the Latin persolvere too; see above 24, 1²
‘als Halslösung’; Schreuer Verbrechenskonk. 167.—G's Zusatz ist richtig, da Raub nicht als Kronprezess aus privater Gerichtsbarkeit (s. d. Gl 1e. 24b. 37h) ausgenommen war
‘as redemption of the neck’; Schreuer Verbrechenskonk. 167.—G's addition is correct, since robbery was not excepted from private jurisdiction (see that word in Gl 1e. 24b. 37h) as a plea of the Crown
Cf. In. 9; 31. This translation follows Liebermann, but see Toller, Suppl. p. 243, s.v. forgildan, ii a.
Liebermann regards G’s addition as probably representing actual practice.
